objective: Freeze and qualify the smallest offline-only paired-evaluation foundation required before any G03b provider experiment or G04 empirical outcome evaluation: an eval-isolated runner, fail-closed terminal-observation and recall invariants, a prospectively bounded verifier-supported envelope, and fixed comparison decision rules.

supported_qualification_envelope.unsupported_rule: Go and Rust remain explicit verifier_unsupported terminal outer-denominator states. They are not silently dropped, pooled into supported languages, or treated as negative outcomes.
supported_qualification_envelope.activation_boundary: Any future positive qualification could apply only to the exact supported language/mechanism cells. Broad-language or universal agent activation remains prohibited.
supported_qualification_envelope.G07_interpretation: This foundation may qualify G07 only for the bounded supported envelope; aggregate six-subject coverage remains partial because Go and Rust are unsupported.

paired_runner_contract.scope: Evaluation-only in-memory orchestration over synthetic fixtures. It may call the current bounded falsifier arm and an agent arm whose only evidence operations route through AgentReadOnlyTools.
paired_runner_contract.fail_closed_tool_rule: Unknown, malformed, out-of-budget, digest-drifted, or unavailable tool requests produce a terminal abstention or failure; they never fall through to filesystem, database, network, subprocess, arbitrary callable, or mutation access.
paired_runner_contract.offline_backend: Scripted deterministic fixtures only. No production model, credential, provider backend, or raw prospective source may be loaded by this receipt.

terminal_and_recall_invariants.complete_pair_rule: Every frozen issue-group identity has exactly one terminal observation for each arm. A missing or duplicate arm observation blocks evaluation and remains in the denominator.
terminal_and_recall_invariants.recall_rule: For an actionable human outcome, only confirmed counts as recalled. Killed, unresolved, abstained, failed, timed out, budget exhausted, parser failed, verifier failed, and missing all count as not recalled; they remain reviewable and visible.
terminal_and_recall_invariants.monotonic_safety_rule: The agent may not kill or omit an actionable identity that the baseline confirmed. Any such identity is an automatic G04 failure, independent of pooled metrics.
terminal_and_recall_invariants.non_actionable_rule: For a non-actionable outcome, killed counts as correctly rejected; confirmed is a false positive; unresolved or abstained remains neither silently correct nor excluded.
terminal_and_recall_invariants.outcome_blinding: Both arms and all terminal chronology are frozen before human outcomes are accessible.

frozen_future_packet_contract.basis: The already-frozen historical descriptive reference contains 40 decided identities. This is a fixed qualification packet size, not a production threshold or broad representativeness claim.
frozen_future_packet_contract.identity: Stable issue-group hashes only, deduplicated before selection.
frozen_future_packet_contract.ordering: Outcome-blind round-robin by supported source family, then mechanism cell, then stable identity hash.
frozen_future_packet_contract.family_rule: All four supported source families must contribute at least one eligible identity; no family may contribute more than half the packet.
frozen_future_packet_contract.shortfall_rule: If exactly 40 eligible issue groups cannot be frozen before outcomes, the later packet gate stops as insufficient. It may not activate remaining sources, reserves, unsupported languages, or post-outcome substitution.
frozen_future_packet_contract.both_class_rule: Both outcome classes are required for a final qualification, but this can be checked only after blinded review and cannot be repaired by post-outcome packet replacement.

frozen_future_decision_rules.reporting_unit: Stable issue-group identity with paired arm observations and one blinded human outcome.
metrics: provider input, output, cache-read, and cache-write tokens
frozen_future_decision_rules.G04_pass: Agent recall is at least baseline recall overall and in every reportable subgroup, and zero baseline-confirmed actionable identity is killed or omitted by the agent.
frozen_future_decision_rules.G03b_pass: G04 passes; agent precision is at least baseline precision; neither arm has incomplete terminal observations or unavailable usage; cost per uniquely validated issue is available; and the agent is strictly better on at least one of unique validated issues, precision, recall, abstention coverage, or cost per uniquely validated issue without being worse on any of those metrics.
frozen_future_decision_rules.subgroup_rule: Family, mechanism, language, and detector subgroups are reportable only when membership was frozen pre-outcome, both outcome classes are present, and both arms are complete. An unavailable subgroup blocks a broad qualification claim and cannot be hidden by pooled results.
frozen_future_decision_rules.zero_denominator_rule: Undefined precision, recall, or cost-per-validated-issue remains unavailable and blocks a pass; it is never assigned zero or one.
frozen_future_decision_rules.insufficient_rule: Packet shortfall, one-class outcomes, incomplete arms, unknown usage, unsupported pricing, unreportable required subgroup, or failure of either pass rule yields insufficient or not-qualified evidence; no threshold, cohort, or packet may be repaired after outcomes.

sequence: Verify every frozen digest, main branch, empty index, byte-identical production store, and absence of all authorized output paths before writing.
Write the decision protocol and evaluation-only agent prompt before constructing the runner.
Implement the isolated paired runner without modifying any production challenger, facade, configuration, CLI, store, scanner, retrieval, map, pipeline, or prompt path.

Run synthetic positive, negative, abstention, unsupported-language, malformed-tool, budget, digest-drift, missing-arm, duplicate-arm, unknown-usage, zero-denominator, subgroup, and monotonic-recall tests.
Persist one aggregate artifact and one descriptive result; verify the production store byte-identical and stop.

It cannot execute or pass G03b, perform empirical G04 evaluation, inspect or select findings, claim broad-language safety, activate production behavior, or close OPT-010.
